## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      4 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 6 may 2026 - 14 oct 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Jessica Cahanin_, 14 oct 2026, 1/5: "The updates suck, the app glitches regularly, and they continually taking features away from the free app to put it behind the paywall to make you purchase their *premium* version. It stinks because I've used this app for close to 15 years for tracking my meals but will now be looking for a different app and slowly transitioning all of my saved recipes and meals somewhere else. I don't mind the ads for using a free app, but taking away the features that I've been using is my final straw."
            2. _Kai Raphael_, 11 oct 2026, 1/5: "app is suddenly really slow"
            3. _Thorsten Mootz_, 30 ago 2026, 1/5: "Neues Update ist ganz schlimm und benutzerunfreundlich. If it's not broken, don't fix it..."
<!--/ir-theme-->
